name: Anna Griese
office: Saugus Union School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 2

items.text: Anna Griese is a member of the Saugus Union School District Governing Board, representing Trustee Area 2. She was elected in 2022. In December 2025 she was board clerk and nominated herself for board president; the board chose Matthew Watson 4-1. Griese said she would continue advocating for parents and teachers.

items.text: In 2026 she asked the board to be more open about difficult discussions in public. During the superintendent search she pointed to student behavior as a challenge and called for new classroom protocols.
